details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/cost_audit.py:line ~459 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: `fallback_wall_clock_ms` was made keyword-only, so any external positional caller of `parse_log(log_text, 5000)` will raise `TypeError`.
  WHY: Internal callers already use keyword syntax, so the breakage is limited to external consumers of this module.
- scripts/collect_workflow_logs.py:line ~1482 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The refactored log-excerpt path now always extracts full logs before truncating them, increasing I/O and memory use versus the previous excerpt-based fallback.
  WHY: This is a performance regression for large log archives because the full zip must be downloaded and decompressed even when only excerpts are needed.
- scripts/collect_workflow_logs.py:line ~1154 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: `_full_logs_to_text` concatenates all step logs without any size bound, which can create very large in-memory strings.
  WHY: The concatenated log text is then scanned multiple times by `parse_log`, so verbose runs can consume significant memory and CPU.
- .github/workflows/ci.yml:460 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The comment about `mode-judge-review-blocked.txt` is misleading about the line-cap rationale.
  WHY: The reviewer says the prompt is 156 lines and the 230-line cap is an exception above the standard, so the comment should state that more clearly.
- scripts/codex_heartbeat.sh:176-178 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: `_forward_signal` relies on `child.poll()` and then process-group checks in a way that can mis-handle edge cases, including missing process groups.
  WHY: If the child exits between checks or `os.getpgid()` fails, the forwarding logic can behave unpredictably or target the wrong process group.
- scripts/review_agents_md_materiality.sh:143-148 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: `classify_path` mixes full-path checks with basename-only checks, which can misclassify nested config files.
  WHY: A nested file like `src/package.json` can be treated as high-materiality even though the root-level-only intent would not match it.
- scripts/codex_heartbeat.sh:248-250 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The heartbeat wrapper transforms negative child return codes into `128+signal`, which can change how signal terminations are reported.
  WHY: A child killed by a signal such as `SIGKILL` will be surfaced as a translated exit code, which may not match the caller’s expectations.
- scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh:Line reference: The reviewer circuit breaker logic around health state persistence | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The reviewer health-state JSON is written without visible directory creation logic.
  WHY: On a fresh checkout, writing `.ai/review_runtime/pr-<PR>/reviewer_health_state.json` can fail with `No such file or directory`.
- scripts/cost_audit.py:~300-320 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: `aggregate_run_cost_telemetry` may append the same wall-clock samples multiple times while processing workflows.
  WHY: The list can grow unnecessarily large and may double-count metrics when runs span multiple workflow files.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:Various (new env vars added) | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The new environment variables use inconsistent default encodings (`"0"`, `"1"`, `"false"`, `"true"`-style patterns).
  WHY: The shell checks handle both forms, but the inconsistency can confuse operators and drift from existing variable conventions.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
